name: LIA
short_description: Lightning Intelligent Assistant that automates progress note generation using NLP, saving behavioral health clinicians 50-60% documentation time.
long_description: LIA (Lightning Intelligent Assistant) is Lightning Step's AI-powered progress note feature that uses natural language processing to automatically generate customized progress notes for behavioral health clinicians. The ISO 42001-certified feature automates documentation using predefined templates for consistency and accuracy, transcribes video sessions into SOAP-style clinical notes, and reduces documentation time by 50-60%. Praesum Healthcare expanded LIA from 100 to over 300 clinicians, reporting 45,000+ hours saved annually - equivalent to 22 full-time employees. Lightning Step merged with Sunwave Health in October 2025 under BVP Forge investment, creating a combined behavioral health technology platform.
one_liner: AI progress notes for Lightning Step EMR saving clinicians 50-60% documentation time.

faqs.q: What is LIA by Lightning Step?
faqs.a: LIA (Lightning Intelligent Assistant) is an AI-powered progress note feature that uses natural language processing to automatically generate customized progress notes. It transcribes video sessions into SOAP-style clinical notes and reduces documentation time by 50-60%.

faqs.q: How much time does LIA save clinicians?
faqs.a: LIA saves clinicians 50-60% of progress notes documentation time per week, which translates to over 12.5 hours saved per month. Praesum Healthcare reported 45,000+ hours saved annually across 300+ clinicians - equivalent to 22 full-time employees.
Yes, LIA is HIPAA compliant with a BAA available. The feature is ISO 42001 certified for AI governance, and patient data is only shared within the integrated Lightning Step EHR platform.

faqs.q: Can I try LIA before purchasing?
faqs.a: Yes, Lightning Step offers a complimentary 30-day trial for LIA. Contact Lightning Step to request access and evaluate the AI progress notes feature.
